title: Learning Self-Orchestration in Decentralized Agent Swarms
abstract: arXiv:2610.22322v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The capabilities of an agent swarm depend on both its individual members and how they coordinate. Yet existing multi-agent systems often train agents within fixed orchestration structures, separating the learning of individual capabilities from the organization of collective behavior. We introduce market-based post-training (MPT), a framework for jointly learning action policies and self-orchestration in decentralized agent swarms. Agents express their willingness to participate through bids, which determine who acts and how collective outcomes provide local training credit. Learning both action and bidding behavior allows individual capabilities and patterns of participation to adapt together without a central coordinating agent. We evaluate MPT on embodied crafting, robot navigation, and deep research. Results show gains over monolithic post-training and confirm that agent participation indeed evolves with learning. translated_title: 去中心化智能体集群中的自编排学习
translated_abstract: 智能体集群的能力既取决于其个体成员，也取决于它们之间的协调方式。然而，现有多智能体系统通常在固定的编排结构中训练智能体，将个体能力的学习与集体行为的组织相互割裂。我们提出了基于市场的后训练，这是一个在去中心化智能体集群中联合学习行动策略与自编排的框架。智能体通过出价来表达其参与意愿，出价决定了谁采取行动，以及集体结果如何转化为局部训练回报。同时学习行动与出价行为，使得个体能力与参与模式能够协同适应，而无需中央协调智能体。我们在具身制作、机器人导航和深度研究任务上对MPT进行了评估。结果表明该方法优于单体式后训练，并证实智能体的参与模式确实随学习过程而演化。
tldr: 该论文提出基于市场的后训练（MPT）框架，让智能体通过学习出价行为来联合优化行动策略与自编排，从而在无中央协调者的情况下实现去中心化智能体集群中个体能力与参与模式的协同适应，在具身制作、机器人导航和深度研究等任务上超越了单体式后训练方法。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces market-based post-training (MPT), a framework that jointly learns action policies and self-orchestration in decentralized agent swarms by training agents to bid for participation, enabling individual capabilities and participation patterns to co-adapt without a central coordinator and outperforming monolithic post-training on embodied crafting, robot navigation, and deep research tasks.
